name: Apache Tika Format Router
mechanism: Detects file types and extracts text and metadata across a broad format set through delegated parsers, with optional Tesseract OCR.
use_when: The corpus contains many office, archive and document formats
A uniform detection and metadata front door is needed
avoid_when: High-fidelity page layout or formulas are primary outputs
Complex PDFs need reliable visual reading order
failure_modes: Delegated parser behavior varies by format
Embedded files cause latency or resource spikes
required_evals: latency and failure rate by file class
